discovery.summary: Local NeuronSphere control plane and environment substrate, runnable on a workstation with Docker as the only prerequisite. Ships two front ends against the same HMD_HOME environment registry: nsctl, a standalone Go binary (src/go/nsctl) that is the preferred entry point for env start/stop/status/purge and the control-plane lifecycle; and the legacy hmd_cli_neuronsphere Python plugin (neuronsphere/neuronsphere_env Cement controllers) which additionally covers repo-scoped operations (DB provisioning, artifact registration, plugin config, DAG-deployed service routing) that nsctl does not yet implement. Plugins under src/python/hmd_cli_neuronsphere/plugins/ (graph, floci, trino, airflow, argo, transform, apache_superset, hive_metastore, dynamodb, jupyter, minio) each contribute enable/prepare_hmd_home hooks for one platform component.

entry_points.description: Front-door doc: explains the nsctl vs hmd_cli_neuronsphere split, what nsctl covers today vs not yet, and quickstart for both.
Getting started with the nsctl Go CLI and a first local environment.
Entry point of the nsctl Go binary; delegates to cmd.Execute().
Root Cobra command wiring for nsctl's subcommands (env, repo, controlplane, artifact, login, version).

Cement Controller (LocalController) defining the legacy hmd neuronsphere/hmd neuronsphere_env CLI commands (up/down/restart, env create/list/stop, db provisioning, plugin config, artifact registration).
Plugin registration point other platform-component plugins (trino, airflow, argo, graph, floci, ...) hook into via enabled/prepare_hmd_home entry points.

capabilities.name: nsctl env start
capabilities.description: Bring up the control plane if needed and start (or auto-register/start) a named local environment; the recommended way to start local NeuronSphere.

capabilities.name: hmd neuronsphere up
capabilities.description: Legacy Python-CLI equivalent of full local platform startup, including DAG-deployed default BOM; slower than nsctl env start but covers verbs nsctl doesn't yet.

capabilities.name: hmd neuronsphere run
capabilities.description: Run a NeuronSphere microservice instance locally against the local environment.

capabilities.name: hmd neuronsphere db-provision
capabilities.description: Provision a local Postgres DB via hmd-ms-dbaccount and register it as a NERD Resource for hmd deploy --local dependency resolution.
